_purpose: Population-level cross-references shown on Notice Detail after a notice is confirmed. Keyed on program + county ONLY. Never on household size, income, or any eligibility input.
_phrasing_rule: Always 'People receiving X are often also eligible for Y.' NEVER 'You may qualify.' The moment copy addresses the individual it becomes an eligibility determination, which SPEC section 10 forbids.
_disclaimer_required: This is general information, not a determination about your household. Contact the program to find out if you qualify.
_disclaimer_required_es: Esta es información general, no una decisión sobre su hogar. Comuníquese con el programa para saber si usted reúne los requisitos.
_confidence_note: categorical_eligibility=true means an official source states receipt of the source program itself establishes eligibility (adjunctive/categorical). Anything marked false is a common co-occurrence, not a rule.

CalFresh.name: California LifeLine
CalFresh.what: Discounted home phone or cell phone service.
CalFresh.what_es: Servicio de teléfono fijo o celular con descuento.
CalFresh.basis: CPUC lists CalFresh/SNAP as a qualifying program for California LifeLine.

CalFresh.name: WIC
CalFresh.what: Food, formula, and nutrition help for pregnant people and children under 5.
CalFresh.what_es: Alimentos, fórmula y ayuda de nutrición para personas embarazadas y niños menores de 5 años.
CalFresh.basis: Receipt of CalFresh, Medi-Cal, or CalWORKs establishes adjunctive income eligibility for WIC. Category and residency requirements still apply.

CalFresh.name: LIHEAP energy assistance
CalFresh.what: Help paying gas and electric bills, and emergency help if service is shut off.
CalFresh.what_es: Ayuda para pagar las facturas de servicios públicos, y ayuda de emergencia si le cortan el servicio.
CalFresh.basis: Separate income test, but CalFresh households commonly qualify and LIHEAP receipt itself qualifies you for LifeLine.

CalFresh.name: Free school meals
CalFresh.what: Free breakfast and lunch at school.
CalFresh.what_es: Desayuno y almuerzo gratis en la escuela.
CalFresh.basis: CalFresh households are directly certified for free school meals. California also serves universal free meals to all public school students regardless of income.
CalFresh.TODO_verify: Verify the current status of California Universal Meals before shipping this copy -- if all students already receive free meals, the useful message is 'you do not need to apply', not 'you may be eligible'.

CalFresh.name: Medi-Cal
CalFresh.what_es: Cobertura de salud gratuita o de bajo costo.
CalFresh.basis: Separate program with its own rules, but CalFresh and Medi-Cal households overlap heavily and both are administered by the same county agency.

CalFresh/CalWORKs.name: Subsidized child care
CalFresh/CalWORKs.what: Help paying for child care while you work or attend school.
CalFresh/CalWORKs.what_es: Ayuda para pagar el cuidado de niños mientras usted trabaja o estudia.
CalFresh/CalWORKs.basis: CalWORKs participants have access to Stage 1/2/3 child care.

Medi-Cal.name: Medi-Cal Dental
Medi-Cal.what: Dental coverage included with Medi-Cal at no extra cost.
Medi-Cal.what_es: Cobertura dental incluida con Medi-Cal sin costo adicional.
Medi-Cal.basis: Dental benefits are part of Medi-Cal coverage.

Medi-Cal.name: In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS)
Medi-Cal.what: Pays someone to help with daily tasks at home so you can stay out of a care facility.
Medi-Cal.what_es: Paga a alguien para ayudar con las tareas diarias en casa para que no tenga que ir a un centro de cuidado.
Medi-Cal.basis: Requires Medi-Cal plus an assessed need for care.

SSI.name: CalFresh
SSI.what: Monthly money for groceries on an EBT card.
SSI.what_es: Dinero cada mes para comprar comida con una tarjeta EBT.
SSI.basis: SSI recipients in California became eligible for CalFresh in 2019; many still do not know this.
SSI._note: High-value cross-reference. SSI recipients were excluded from CalFresh for decades and awareness remains low.

public_charge_note._purpose: Renders INLINE with the cross-reference list, never behind a link. Suggesting extra programs to a mixed-status household is exactly where fear does its damage.
public_charge_note.en: Using most public benefits does not affect your immigration case. Food assistance, health coverage, and school meals are not counted in a public charge decision. Benefits used by your children do not count against you.
public_charge_note.es: Usar la mayoría de los beneficios públicos no afecta su caso de inmigración. La ayuda de alimentos, la cobertura de salud y las comidas escolares no cuentan en una decisión de carga pública. Los beneficios que usan sus hijos no cuentan en su contra.

CLAUDE.md section 9 prefers official CDSS wording where it exists; these programme descriptions have no CDSS equivalent because they are not CDSS forms. A Spanish speaker must read these before ship.
